title: β-Hairpin Fold Peptide Brush Polymers
authors: Oktawiec J; Nadeem H; Ebrahim OM; Chen Y; Barbut C; Byrnes J; Thompson MP; Shukla D; Gianneschi NC
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过实验与分子动力学模拟结合，探究肽刷聚合物中β-发夹肽段结构稳定性，虽对象为合成聚合物而非天然蛋白质，但其结构-功能关系及模拟方法对蛋白质结构计算研究有借鉴意义。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Peptide-brush polymers prepared via graft-through polymerization of peptide-based olefinic monomers form Protein-Like Polymers (PLPs) with demonstrated utility as chemical biology tools for modulating intracellular protein–protein interactions and are in development as a emerging class of therapeutic. This favorable bioactivity has been achieved in part by mimicking some of the structural and functional features of proteins, such as their dynamic, globular solution-phase structures, ability to insert into lipid membranes and enter cells, and tendency to enforce α-helicity in peptide side chains. However, because structure leads to function, insight into the structure of these proteomimetic polymers, particularly their overall tertiary structure and the extent to which this influences the brush peptide structure, is incomplete. To further this understanding, we prepared a set of brush polymers incorporating the trpzip2 peptide sequence, commonly used as a model system for protein folding. We examine these polymers via circular dichroism spectroscopy, infrared spectroscopy, and small-angle X-ray scattering, coupled with insights from molecular dynamics simulations. Here, a loss of the β-hairpin structure of the monomer is observed regardless of polymer composition, and simulations corroborate that the polymer backbone destabilizes local secondary structure, restricting peptide motion and altering the accessible free-energy landscape. This study provides insight into design rules governing these synthetic polymer-based proteomimetics.
abstract_zh:
摘要

通过基于肽的烯烃单体的接枝-through聚合制备的肽刷聚合物形成蛋白质样聚合物（Protein-Like Polymers, PLPs），已证明其作为调节细胞内蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的化学生物学工具具有实用性，并正在开发为一类新兴治疗药物。这种有利的生物活性部分通过模拟蛋白质的一些结构和功能特征实现，例如其动态的球状溶液相结构、插入脂质膜并进入细胞的能力，以及在肽侧链中强制α-螺旋性的倾向。然而，由于结构决定功能，对这些蛋白质模拟聚合物的结构洞察，特别是其整体三级结构及其对刷肽结构的影响程度，仍不完整。为进一步理解这一点，我们制备了一组包含trpzip2肽序列的刷聚合物，该序列通常用作蛋白质折叠的模型系统。我们通过圆二色光谱、红外光谱和小角X射线散射对这些聚合物进行检查，并结合分子动力学模拟的见解。在此，观察到无论聚合物组成如何，单体的β-发夹结构均丧失，模拟结果证实聚合物主链使局部二级结构不稳定，限制肽运动并改变可访问的自由能景观。本研究为这些合成聚合物基蛋白质模拟物的设计规则提供了见解。
